name: soton_bargate_to_portswood
place: Southampton: Bargate -> Civic Centre Road -> Dorset Street (A33) -> Onslow Road -> Portswood
features: lanes that have always been there: Dorset Street's 3-4 lanes for 260 m before the slight right onto Onslow Road

maneuver.instruction: Turn right onto Civic Centre Road.
Enter Charlotte Place and take the 3rd exit onto Dorset Street/A33.
Bear right onto Onslow Road/A335. Continue on A335.
Keep left to take Bevois Hill.
